about.title: About Us
about.description: Learn about Tagadod store and our services
about.intro: Tagadod is a Yemeni online store specializing in high-quality electrical products and machinery. We strive to provide an easy and reliable shopping experience for our customers across Yemen.
about.whatWeOfferText: We offer a wide range of electrical products, industrial and household machinery, as well as maintenance, installation, and repair services by certified engineers and technicians. We ensure product quality and competitive pricing.
about.whyTrustUsText: We are committed to quality and transparency in all our dealings. We provide warranties on our products and services, and our technical support team is ready to help you at any time. Customer satisfaction is our top priority.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: We are happy to hear from you for any inquiries or assistance. You can use one of the following methods:

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Tagadod store privacy policy - how we handle your data
privacy.intro: At Tagadod, we take your privacy seriously. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal data when using our store.
privacy.dataCollectionText: We collect information you provide directly when creating an account or placing an order, such as name, phone number, and address. We may also collect automatic information like IP address and browser type to improve your experience.
privacy.dataUsageText: We use your data to process your orders, communicate with you about our services, improve the shopping experience, and send important notifications. We do not sell or share your personal data with third parties for marketing purposes.
privacy.dataSharingText: We may share your data with service providers necessary to fulfill your orders, such as delivery companies and payment processors, to the minimum extent required.
privacy.yourRightsText: You have the right to access your data, request correction or deletion, and object to its use for certain purposes. Contact us for any inquiries regarding your data.
privacy.disclaimer: Disclaimer: This policy is generic and may need legal review before official launch.

returns.title: Return Policy
returns.description: Product return policy for Tagadod store
returns.intro: We care about customer satisfaction and provide a fair return policy. Returns are subject to the following conditions:
returns.conditionsText: The product must be in its original condition and unused. Return acceptance depends on the product type and condition. Please keep the invoice or order proof.
returns.nonReturnableText: Some used, damaged, or modified products may not be eligible for return. Custom or made-to-order products are not returnable unless there is a manufacturing defect.
returns.processText: To submit a return request, contact our support team with your order number and reason for return. The team will review your request and guide you through the next steps.
returns.contactHint: For return inquiries, contact us at:

shipping.title: Shipping & Delivery
shipping.description: Shipping and delivery information for Tagadod store
shipping.intro: We provide shipping and delivery services to various regions in Yemen. Shipping details vary by location and product type.
shipping.costText: Shipping cost varies by city, distance, and order size. Shipping cost is calculated when confirming the order or by contacting our support team.
shipping.deliveryTimeText: Delivery time is estimated and depends on your geographic location and delivery service availability in your area. Contact us for a more accurate estimate.
shipping.areasText: We cover most major areas in Yemen. Some remote areas may require additional coordination. Contact us to confirm service availability in your area.
shipping.trackingText: You can track your order status through the Orders page in your account or contact our support team for updates.

terms.title: Terms & Conditions
terms.description: Terms and conditions for using Tagadod store
terms.intro: By using Tagadod store, you agree to the following terms and conditions. Please read them carefully.
terms.useOfStoreText: The store is permitted for personal and legitimate commercial use only. Using the store for any illegal or harmful activity is prohibited.
terms.pricingText: All displayed prices are subject to change without prior notice. Product availability is subject to change and we do not guarantee any product is available at all times.
terms.userResponsibilityText: You are responsible for the accuracy of the information provided when creating an account or placing an order. Incorrect information may affect order processing.
terms.limitationText: We strive for accuracy of displayed information but do not guarantee the site is free of errors. We are not liable for any indirect damages resulting from site usage.
terms.modificationsText: We reserve the right to modify these terms and conditions at any time. Modifications will be posted on this page and your continued use of the site constitutes acceptance of modifications.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Answers to the most common questions about Tagadod store
faq.q1: How do I order a product?
faq.a1: Browse products, add what you want to the cart, then click checkout. You will be contacted to confirm the order and arrange delivery.
faq.q2: How do I know if a product is available?
faq.a2: Availability status is shown on each product page. If the product is 'In Stock' you can add it to the cart. If 'Out of Stock' you can contact us for inquiries.
faq.a3: Yes, we provide delivery service to various regions. Cost and duration vary by location. Contact us for delivery details in your area.
faq.a4: You can contact us via phone or email shown on the 'Contact Us' page or through the support section in your account.
faq.a5: Yes, you can return a product according to our return policy. The product must be in its original condition. Contact support to start the return process.
faq.a6: Displayed prices may change without prior notice. The final price is confirmed when confirming the order.
faq.q7: How do I track my order?
faq.a7: You can track your order status through the 'Orders' page in your account. You will also receive notifications about order status.
